description: A stateful pipeline architecture for a CI/CD governance tool, orchestrating static analysis, visual diffing, documentation generation, and telemetry feedback loops to provide architectural insights.

components.name: Analysis Orchestrator
components.description: Acts as the central controller and entry point for the Python execution environment. It manages the analysis lifecycle, determines whether to perform a full or incremental scan based on existing metadata, and coordinates the execution of the static analysis engine.

components.name: Lifecycle Dispatcher
components.description: The primary entry point and command-line interface handler that interprets execution modes and manages the high-level sequence of operations.

components.name: Strategy & Scope Resolver
components.description: Responsible for determining technical parameters of the analysis by loading metadata and calculating analysis depth based on configuration and history.

components.name: State & Delta Manager
components.description: Manages stateful incremental logic, comparing commits against baselines, validating analysis integrity, and providing filesystem context.

components.name: Post-Analysis Auditor
components.description: A diagnostic component that parses generated metadata to produce health reports and identify architectural violations.

components_relations.relation: manages execution context and state validation
queries state for incremental change detection
retrieves configuration defaults for state transitions

components_relations.evidence: Runtime dependency on analysis artifacts (Pickle/JSON) managed by State & Delta Manager within the .codeboarding directory.

components.name: Visual Diffing & Rendering Engine
components.description: Responsible for the structural comparison between the current code state and the baseline. It identifies modified components, relations, and methods, then transforms these differences into Mermaid.js syntax for visual representation within GitHub.

components.name: Diff Analysis & Change Detection
components.description: Identifies the structural delta between the current code state and the baseline, filtering for architecturally significant modifications.

components.name: Mermaid Syntax Generation & Structural Rendering
components.description: Maps architectural entities and their relationships to Mermaid.js syntax, managing hierarchical scoping and visual styling.

components.name: UI Enhancement & CTA Integration
components.description: Enriches rendered diagrams with interactive elements, generating deep links for IDEs and webview URLs.

components.name: Rendering Orchestration
components.description: Acts as the controller for the subsystem, managing the execution lifecycle and sequencing the flow from diff detection to final output.

components_relations.evidence: The orchestration layer initiates the analysis by loading serialized analysis data and invoking the diff builder to identify architectural shifts.
The main controller manages the sequencing of the rendering process, passing the computed diff data to the Mermaid generator.

components_relations.relation: Provides filtered architectural delta for visualization
components_relations.evidence: The rendering logic consumes the filtered component and relation sets produced by the diff analysis to determine which nodes and edges to include in the final diagram.

components_relations.relation: Delegates visual styling and metadata enrichment
components_relations.evidence: During the recursive emission of Mermaid levels, the generator calls UI utilities to sanitize names, apply CSS classes for change status, and inject interactive directives.

components_relations.relation: Queries change status for visual highlighting
components_relations.evidence: UI components query the diff state to determine the appropriate visual representation (e.g., color-coding for additions vs. modifications) for specific architectural scopes.
The diff analysis phase prepares the context (like component IDs and names) used by the UI layer to generate deep links and tooltips.

components.name: Documentation & CTA Generator
components.description: Maps the analyzed code structure back to the physical file system to generate developer-centric documentation. It creates markdown files for components and "Call-to-Action" (CTA) links that facilitate navigation between the code and the architectural view.

components.name: Documentation Workflow Orchestrator
components.description: Manages the end-to-end lifecycle of documentation generation, coordinating analysis artifacts, change detection, and the rendering process.

components.name: Architectural Diff Engine
components.description: Analyzes the delta between architectural states to identify modified components and structural shifts for incremental updates.

components.name: Markdown & Diagram Renderer
components.description: Translates component tree and diff data into structured Markdown and Mermaid.js diagrams.

components.name: Navigation & Linkage Provider
components.description: Generates interactive CTA links and sanitizes identifiers for documentation navigation.

components_relations.evidence: The orchestrator uses diffing logic to identify which files and subtrees require documentation updates based on the current change set.
Direct invocation of the rendering process once the scope of changes has been determined by the orchestrator.

components_relations.relation: Queries structural deltas for visual highlighting
components_relations.evidence: The renderer utilizes diff utilities to determine how to represent modified components within diagrams and text.
The renderer delegates URL sanitization and CTA string construction to the provider to maintain consistent link structures.
The provider includes a CLI entry point that can trigger specific rendering tasks for CTA updates.
The engine provides the filtered data structures that the orchestrator manages as the "State Management" layer for the current run.

components.name: Telemetry & Feedback Provider
components.description: A specialized component that handles the collection and transmission of execution metrics and user feedback. It ensures data is anonymized and transmitted securely to the remote backend for service improvement.

components.name: Contextual Metadata Extractor
components.description: Responsible for mining the results of the architectural analysis to provide context for the telemetry by identifying impacted components and calculating metrics.

components.name: Feedback Assembler
components.description: Acts as the data transformation layer that aggregates environment variables, user feedback, and architectural context into a standardized JSON schema.

components.name: Remote Dispatcher
components.description: Manages the egress of data to the external service, handling HTTP authentication, POST requests, and response management.

components_relations.evidence: The main execution loop in the Dispatcher triggers the assembly process to transform internal state into a structured JSON payload.
The Dispatcher queries the Extractor to determine if telemetry is globally disabled or to resolve the target host before initiating network egress.
The Assembler pulls specific metadata (commands, keys, and character limits) from the Extractor to populate the telemetry schema.
The Assembler relies on utility functions co-located in the Dispatcher component for generating distinct IDs and capping feedback length.
The Orchestrator executes the analysis engine to produce the analysis.json file, which serves as the primary data input for the Rendering Engine's diffing logic.
